workouts.weightHint: Enter the total load moved per repetition, including both dumbbells when applicable. Count unilateral repetitions consistently. Empty kg means unknown; 0 kg contributes no external volume.
workouts.formula: Volume = repetitions × total kg. Each exercise’s volume is divided between its groups using relative weights: target 1, synergist 0.5, normalized so their shares sum to 100%. Each group is counted once. Group % = allocated volume / the routine’s total volume × 100. Missing mappings remain unattributed. This is a conventional workload allocation, not measured muscle activation.
